decisive_items: A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.
Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
a linear scar was observed in the lower-left abdominal region
response.rationale: Histopathology shows endometrial glands and stroma in a subcutaneous nodule near a surgical scar, with cyclic pain, strongly supporting abdominal wall endometrioma.
